column1: # Fallback judge corpus, read by cases-fallback.sh after its inline rows. One row per line,
# VERDICT@command, judged with the guards degraded and again healthy (the script-content rule's
# mode). Data, not a script: a row may name the destructive class it must refuse.
# Words after an `sh -c` body are its arguments, never a command: a script that only passes
# "$1" after a python -c body names no git subcommand.
